Once upon a time, a small fox found a blue stone.
The fox carried the stone home and showed it to a friend.<|endoftext|>
In a quiet village, a robot learned how to plant flowers.
Every morning the robot watered the garden and watched it grow.<|endoftext|>
The moon was bright, and the children told stories beside the river.
They laughed, shared warm bread, and promised to meet again.<|endoftext|>
Once upon a time, a small fox found another shining stone.
The friendly robot helped the fox build a safe little home.<|endoftext|>
